name: Outtake
title: Outtake | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Find the moment. Make it yours.
description: Start with a scene you remember. Find it in your local video, review the proposed cut, and shape a clip, GIF, or still worth keeping.
alt: A real Claude Code request opens a local Mighty Boosh clip in Outtake; the clip plays in a steady workspace while GIF is selected, followed by the exported GIF.
caption: Ask your agent, review your own moment, choose GIF. A 26-second edit of real Claude Code and Outtake footage.
flow_title: From a remembered scene to a finished cut.
flow_intro: Bring the clue and the source collection. Your agent helps find the exchange and opens it for review.
steps: Start with a title, a line, an action, or a scene. Choose the source folders the tool may inspect.
Check the proposed cut, adjust its boundaries, and loop the selected range. Keep source captions or add your own timed text.
Save MP4, GIF, or PNG with a sharing preset. Reopen a retained result when you want another version; original media stays unchanged.
detail_title: A workspace for the remembered detail.
details: Smart finding uses permitted metadata, captions, and sampled frames. It retains evidence and uncertainty alongside proposed cuts.
Trim with two handles, place the playhead, and preview rendered edits. Captions and timed text stay part of the editing flow.
Saved Outputs gathers exports for downloading and reopening. Earlier exports and original media remain available.
prompt: Use Outtake to help me find a scene in my local video collection. Read outtake --help, help me choose the permitted folders, and narrow the moment from my description. Open the proposed cut so I can trim and export it.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+, Git, uv, and FFmpeg with FFprobe. Source video must be locally accessible, including through a mounted share.
model_note: Smart finding needs its own configured vision-capable model. Explicit cuts, previews, exports, and caption handling work locally without a model.
